name: LVPWA World Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, defended at least once a month.

name: LVPWA North American Championship
epitaph: The promotion's number-two title, declared vacant if not defended within thirty days.

name: LVPWA Featherweight Championship
epitaph: Open to wrestlers weighing 235 pounds and under.

name: LVPWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top tag team title.
